span.p:
No valid SE attestation, or MarkUntrusted
(3 hard challenge failures, runtime claim mismatch)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Registration blob signed by SE P-256 key
verifyProviderAttestation → SetAttested(true)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Periodic challenge every DefaultChallengeInterval = 5 min
30 s reply timeout · fresh reply ≤ 16 min for routing

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
MDM SecurityInfo cross-check (per connection)
sip=true · secure_boot=full · serial matches SE blob
GrantHardwareEvidenceAtEpochIfNotUntrusted

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
mda_verified — Apple DevicePropertiesAttestation
SetMDAProofIfHardwareBound (needs hardware first)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
code_attested — APNs code-identity challenge
GrantProcessCodeAttested (needs same K + APNs token)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Routing private text requires: hardware ∧ fresh challenge ∧ code_attested (when enforced)
providerLivenessGateReasonLocked → providerSupportsPrivateTextLocked
